internships.title: Back-End Developer
internships.company: Faculty of Insutrial and Engineering Technology, Kalimantan's Institute of Technology
internships.description: Developed and maintained the backend system for the FRTI ITK service information website, providing APIs and content management functionality for public information, academic services, faculty documents, news, agendas, and administrative services.
highlights: Developed RESTful APIs using Laravel to support the public website and administrative CMS.
Implemented authentication and authorization for administrators using Laravel Sanctum, including active-admin validation and login rate limiting.
Built backend modules for news, agendas, study programs, lecturers, administrative services, documents, PPID, accreditation, organizational structure, and faculty information.
Implemented CRUD operations, request validation, media uploads, image handling, and structured API responses for frontend integration.
Integrated dynamic content between the admin CMS, backend database, and public Next.js website so changes made by administrators are reflected automatically on the public website.
Designed relational data structures for lecturers, study programs, accreditation records, organizational members, educational staff, administrative services, and PPID content.
Implemented file and media management for lecturer photos, staff photos, accreditation certificates, organizational charts, news images, and administrative documents.
Integrated Google Calendar data for faculty agenda information and implemented dynamic agenda rendering on the public website.
Implemented news view tracking and view-count-based popular news ranking.
Added API-driven loading states and skeleton interfaces to prevent dummy data flashes while frontend content is fetched from the backend.
Performed API testing and validation for authentication, authorization, validation errors, missing resources, file size limits, and other HTTP response scenarios.
